correctness.rationale: On O=K_2,2,2 with 12 lexicographic cross-part edges, all acyclic orientations are exactly those induced by 6! topological vertex permutations, encoded as distinct 12-bit strings. Independently computed the 426 distinct orientations, and for each tested all twelve one-bit reversals for membership in that complete set. The histogram is 288 vertices of degree5, 120 of degree6 and 18 of degree8, no degree7; handshake gives 1152 flip edges. The full 48 automorphisms (three part permutations and within-part swaps) give 15 orientation orbits (pinned verify_octahedron.py independently enumerates them). A separate independently coded strong-cube cut test among 4096 orientations yields 426 strongly connected cube orientations with the same reversible-edge histogram, consistent with planar orientation duality; the octahedron graphical zonotope is five-dimensional and its simple vertices correspond to the 288 degree-5 orientations. Exact finite completeness follows from topological orders and exhaustive finite masks, not sampled orientation logs.
